Ford F-Series Decals for Apex Construction

Are you interested in increasing your company’s visibility?

We’re Vinyl Wrap Toronto, and we can help you do just that. We specialize in creating custom decals for companies of all sizes, and we can design a decal for your business that will make your brand stand out from the competition.

We recently completed a project for Apex Construction, a local construction company. Apex wanted to increase their visibility by putting decals on their pickup truck. We used bright blue and dark blue colors to create a bold statement that would be visible from far away—and it was! The decals were so eye-catching that many people stopped by to find out what they were advertising!

If you’d like to increase brand awareness with custom decal designs for your business or organization, call us today.
